claims.claim: 24 speed sports bicycle with hand selector gear controller
claims.evidence: Witness only reports a road bicycle with rear derailleur/drivetrain visible; no readable gear count or hand shifter details.
No close-up or readable markings to confirm material; witness did not report aluminum specifically.
No speed rating or component specs shown in the witness report.
No receipt/warranty or service record shown in the witness report.
Witness did not test brakes/gears; only noted drivetrain looks used and chain area visible.
Witness mentions light dust/road grime but does not confirm rust status across the whole frame.
No component part numbers/brand markings or close-ups to verify originality.

risks.risk: Gear system may not shift correctly under load (seller claims perfect gears, but no functional test shown).
risks.proof: Video/clip of a full gear sweep while pedaling (front and rear shifting), showing clean engagement in all gears.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used road bike with unverified drivetrain performance (assume possible adjustment/maintenance needed).

risks.risk: Brakes may be weak or misadjusted (seller claims perfect brakes, but no bite/test shown).
risks.proof: Clip of hard braking from a short roll, showing brake lever feel and wheel stop without slipping; close-up of brake pads and caliper alignment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes not confirmed (assume pad wear/adjustment may be required).

risks.risk: Tire condition and puncture risk (tread depth, sidewall cracks) not shown beyond general appearance.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires: tread wear, sidewalls, and any embedded punctures; plus a quick spin showing wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Price with tires treated as unknown wear (assume replacement may be needed).

risks.risk: Wheel health: alignment/true, bearing play, rim dents not fully visible from limited angles.
risks.proof: Clip showing wheels spun in place (side view) to check wobble; close-ups of rims for dents and hub/bearing play check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as wheels of unknown true/bearing condition (possible servicing).

risks.risk: Frame size and hidden damage (cracks/dents/rust spots) not readable or shown in close-ups.
risks.proof: Photos of frame close-ups at stress points (head tube, bottom bracket, seat tube, chain stays) plus readable frame size/serial if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown frame condition and size (assume worst-case minor damage/fit uncertainty).

risks.risk: Unclear brand/model reduces resale value and makes parts compatibility uncertain.
risks.proof: Clear photos of any brand/model text on frame and components (shifters, derailleur, crank) or a photo of the serial/label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown road bicycle due to missing identification.

proof_requests: Clear photos of the frame showing any brand/model text and the frame size (including head tube/seat tube area).
Video of shifting through all gears while pedaling (front and rear), showing smooth engagement.
Video/clip of braking test (front and rear) from a short roll, plus close-ups of brake pads and calipers.
Close-up photos of both tires (tread depth, sidewalls, any cracks/punctures) and the rim edges.
Clip showing wheels spun to check wobble and a check for bearing play at the hubs.
Photos of drivetrain wear points (chain, cassette/freewheel, chainrings) and any visible rust spots.
response.reason: The witness can confirm it is a road bicycle, but key details needed to price confidently (gear/brake functionality, tire/wheel/frame condition, and exact identification) are not proven by the report. Request the specific proof clips/photos before setting a reliable price.
